limitations: Only three previously verified AT/status queries; no mode set, reset, selection, dial, hangup, APN, firmware, IMEI or persistent module write.
Small bound DNS/TLS HEAD test reuses the existing guarded probe; no other adapter fallback, default resolver or application proxy.
Read-only before/after comparison covers observed adapters, network driver metadata, addresses, IP interfaces, DNS and active routing table; lifetimes and packet counters are excluded.
Point-in-time comparison is not continuous monitoring or an absolute no-failure guarantee; autonomous system/module changes remain possible.
No drone flight, power measurement, Apple direct-USB test or independent inspection of future firmware state; future drone compatibility is not guaranteed by this test.
Raw device identifiers, addresses, routes, DNS and detailed exceptions remain private. No repair, driver reinstall, interface disable or system setting change is attempted on failure.
Bound IPv4 UDP DNS and direct TCP/TLS HEAD requests only; no application proxy, default resolver or other adapter fallback.
Only target-configured DNS servers and two fixed public hostnames are considered. No redirects or webpage bodies are downloaded.
No driver, APN, SIM selection, USB mode, route, DNS, proxy, service, security setting or other adapter was changed.
Counters may also include background traffic and are not the sole path proof. Source binding, IP_UNICAST_IF, route attribution and TLS validation are required.
No packet capture, independent audit of third-party system interception, bandwidth benchmark, voice or Apple device test was performed.
Source addresses, interface GUIDs, DNS servers, resolved addresses and exception details remain private. Success is a historical test result, not a guarantee of all sites or future stability.
